segments.en: Hello, English learners.
segments.zh: 各位英语学习者，大家好。

segments.en: Welcome back to EnglishPod.
segments.zh: 欢迎回到 EnglishPod。

segments.en: My name is Marco.
segments.zh: 我叫 Marco。

segments.en: And I'm Erica.
segments.zh: 我叫 Erica。

segments.en: And today we are going to be talking about the weather.
segments.zh: 今天我们将谈论天气。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And you know, Marco, this is a really, really useful and important topic in English, isn't it?
segments.zh: 你知道，Marco，这是一个非常非常有用和重要的英语主题，不是吗？

segments.en: Exactly, because if you ever travel abroad, you always want to know about the weather, right?
segments.zh: 没错，因为如果你去国外旅行，你总是想知道天气，对吧？

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And Anglo people, English people, all they ever do is talk about the weather.
segments.zh: 盎格鲁人，英国人，他们所做的只是谈论天气。

segments.en: Well, it's an important topic.
segments.zh: 嗯，这是一个重要的话题。

segments.en: You want to know what clothes to wear or if you should take an umbrella.
segments.zh: 你想知道穿什么衣服，或者你是否应该带一把雨伞。

segments.en: Or even when you're making small talk with people.
segments.zh: 甚至当您与人闲聊时。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: So we are going to be taking a look at the weather in the United States.
segments.zh: 所以我们要看看美国的天气。

segments.en: But before we get started with the dialogue, let's take a look at vocabulary preview.
segments.zh: 但在我们开始对话之前，让我们来看看词汇预览。

segments.en: Vocabulary preview.
segments.zh: 词汇预览。

segments.en: Okay, so we have two words we're going to hear in the dialogue.
segments.zh: 好的，我们将在对话中听到两个词。

segments.en: Now the first one is forecast.
segments.zh: 现在第一个是预测。

segments.en: Forecast.
segments.zh: 预测。

segments.en: Weather forecast.
segments.zh: 天气预报。

segments.en: So this is what we listen to or what we see on the television, the weather forecast.
segments.zh: 所以这就是我们在电视上听到的或我们在电视上看到的天气预报。

segments.en: Right, it's like the prediction of the weather.
segments.zh: 没错，就像天气预报一样。

segments.en: Okay, so forecast, can I only use it in the weather?
segments.zh: 好吧，预报，我只能在天气里使用它吗？

segments.en: No, of course you can use it in many other different situations, like in business, for example, forecast sales.
segments.zh: 不，当然，您可以在许多其他不同的情况下使用它，例如在商业中，例如预测销售额。

segments.en: Okay, so the prediction of sales.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以预测销售额。

segments.en: Very good.
segments.zh: 很好。

segments.en: And we have one more word on vocabulary preview, a shower.
segments.zh: 词汇预览里还有一个词：a shower。

segments.en: A shower.
segments.zh: 阵雨。

segments.en: Shower.
segments.zh: 阵雨。

segments.en: Shower.
segments.zh: 阵雨。

segments.en: So when it rains for a short time and it's not too heavy, that's a shower.
segments.zh: 所以短时间、不太大的雨，就叫阵雨。

segments.en: Okay, very good.
segments.zh: 好，很好。

segments.en: So it's very similar to a shower at home.
segments.zh: 所以它非常类似于在家淋浴。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: A little bit of water.
segments.zh: 一点点水。

segments.en: And it doesn't last too long.
segments.zh: 而且不会持续太久。

segments.en: Okay, very good.
segments.zh: 好，很好。

segments.en: So why don't we listen to our dialogue now.
segments.zh: 那么我们为什么不现在听我们的对话。

segments.en: We are going to be listening to the weatherman as he describes the weather in Utah.
segments.zh: 我们将聆听天气预报员的讲话，因为他描述了犹他州的天气。

segments.en: And now let's go to Kenny Williams for today's weather forecast.
segments.zh: 下面请肯尼·威廉姆斯为我们播报今天的天气。

segments.en: Thank you, Bill, and good morning, Salt Lake City.
segments.zh: 谢谢你，比尔，早上好，盐湖城。

segments.en: What's the weather looking like today, Kenny?
segments.zh: 肯尼，今天的天气怎么样？

segments.en: Well, it's a bit of a mixed bag in Utah today.
segments.zh: 今天犹他州各地的天气不太一样。

segments.en: We've got heavy cloud cover here in northern Utah, and we're calling for scattered showers throughout the day, with a daytime high of 45 degrees.
segments.zh: 犹他州北部阴云密布，全天可能有零星阵雨，白天最高气温华氏四十五度。

segments.en: Now, if we move down to the south of the state, we can see that a cold front is moving in.
segments.zh: 再看该州南部，一股冷锋正移入。

segments.en: We can expect clear skies, but it will be quite cold, with temperatures hovering around the 30 degree mark.
segments.zh: 虽然天空晴朗，但天气很冷，气温在华氏三十度左右徘徊。

segments.en: It's a chilly day, folks, so don't forget your coats.
segments.zh: 今天挺冷的，各位别忘了穿外套。

segments.en: What about tomorrow, Kenny?
segments.zh: 肯尼，明天呢？

segments.en: Do you have good news for us?
segments.zh: 你有好消息要告诉我们吗？

segments.en: Well, it'll be a rainy day for northern Utah.
segments.zh: 犹他州北部明天会下雨。

segments.en: We can expect some isolated downpours in the morning.
segments.zh: 早晨局部地区可能有大雨。

segments.en: Winds will be coming in from the northeast, with gusts reaching 23 miles per hour.
segments.zh: 东北风，阵风时速可达二十三英里。

segments.en: Salt Lake City can expect the rain to turn to sleet in the evening.
segments.zh: 盐湖城傍晚可能由雨转为雨夹雪。

segments.en: Things are looking a bit better for the south.
segments.zh: 南部的情况要好一些。

segments.en: We'll see cloudy skies with a chance of showers.
segments.zh: 多云，有阵雨的可能。

segments.en: Later in the day, we can expect partly cloudy skies with a forecast high of 38 degrees.
segments.zh: 晚些时候转为局部多云，预计最高气温华氏三十八度。

segments.en: You heard it, folks.
segments.zh: 各位都听到了吧。

segments.en: It's going to be a cold one.
segments.zh: 会很冷的。

segments.en: That's right, Bill.
segments.zh: 没错，比尔。

segments.en: We'll have more later on today on the 6 o'clock news.
segments.zh: 更多天气消息请关注今晚六点新闻。

segments.en: That's the weather forecast for this morning.
segments.zh: 以上就是今早的天气预报。

segments.en: All right, so we listened to the weather forecast and it doesn't seem like nice weather in Utah, huh?
segments.zh: 好吧，所以我们听了天气预报，犹他州的天气看起来不太好，对吧？

segments.en: No, it certainly doesn't.
segments.zh: 不，确实不是。

segments.en: I don't think that I'd really like to live there.
segments.zh: 我不认为我真的很想住在那里。

segments.en: Well, maybe it's winter or something like that.
segments.zh: 也许现在是冬天之类的。

segments.en: Well, I guess, yeah, maybe it's good for skiing.
segments.zh: 好吧，也许挺适合滑雪的。

segments.en: Okay, so now I think it's time for us to take a look at some of those maybe difficult words that we may have listened to in this dialogue in Language Takeaway.
segments.zh: 好的，现在该看看我们在这段对话中可能听过的一些比较难的词了，就在语言要点。

segments.en: Language Takeaway.
segments.zh: 语言要点。

segments.en: All right, here we're going to look at some words and phrases that you can use to describe the weather.
segments.zh: 好吧，这里我们将看看一些你可以用来描述天气的单词和短语。

segments.en: Now, the first one, we heard in the weather forecast that they were calling for scattered showers.
segments.zh: 现在，第一个词。我们在天气预报里听到预报说会有零星阵雨。

segments.en: Scattered showers.
segments.zh: 零散的阵雨。

segments.en: Scatter.
segments.zh: 分散。

segments.en: Scattered, if something is scattered.
segments.zh: 分散的，如果有什么东西是分散的。

segments.en: It's sort of like it's a little bit of that thing everywhere.
segments.zh: 这有点像到处都是那种东西。

segments.en: Okay, so and we already talked about what showers were.
segments.zh: 好吧，我们已经讨论过阵雨是什么了。

segments.en: Right, so shower is a small amount of rain.
segments.zh: 对，所以阵雨是少量的雨。

segments.en: Okay, very good.
segments.zh: 好，很好。

segments.en: To better understand when something is scattered, imagine that we are in a playground and the children are playing in the playground.
segments.zh: 为了更好地理解什么时候有东西散落，想象我们在操场上，孩子们在操场上玩耍。

segments.en: So the children are scattered everywhere.
segments.zh: 于是孩子们散落在各处。

segments.en: Some of them are playing on the swing.
segments.zh: 有些孩子在荡秋千。

segments.en: Some of them are playing on the grass or in the sandbox.
segments.zh: 他们中的一些人在草地上或沙箱里玩耍。

segments.en: So children, a little bit of children in every different spot.
segments.zh: 所以孩子们，在每个不同的地方都有一点点孩子。

segments.en: So if we think that the city is a playground, maybe in one part of the city there's a little bit of rain but not in the other part.
segments.zh: 因此，如果我们认为这座城市是一个游乐场，也许在城市的一个地方有一点点雨，但在另一部分却没有。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: That's a scattered shower.
segments.zh: 那就是零星阵雨。

segments.en: Very good.
segments.zh: 很好。

segments.en: Moving on to our second word, we have hovering.
segments.zh: 继续我们的第二个词，我们有悬停。

segments.en: Hovering.
segments.zh: 徘徊。

segments.en: Temperatures hovering around the 30-degree mark.
segments.zh: 温度徘徊在 30 度左右。

segments.en: The temperature is hovering around.
segments.zh: 气温在某个数值上下徘徊。

segments.en: Okay, so when I say the temperatures are hovering.
segments.zh: 好的，所以当我说温度在徘徊时。

segments.en: You mean it's approximately.
segments.zh: 你的意思是它大约是。

segments.en: Okay, so they can move up and down.
segments.zh: 好的，这样他们就可以上下移动。

segments.en: So maybe it'll be a little bit warmer than 30 degrees or a little bit colder.
segments.zh: 所以可能比 30 度暖一点，也可能冷一点。

segments.en: Yes.
segments.zh: 是的。

segments.en: So if you think of hovering as floating.
segments.zh: 因此，如果您认为悬停是浮动的。

segments.en: Okay, very good.
segments.zh: 好，很好。

segments.en: So why don't we listen to some more examples of how we could use hovering in different situations.
segments.zh: 那么，我们为什么不听更多关于如何在不同情况下使用悬停的例子。

segments.en: Example 1.
segments.zh: 例句一。

segments.en: Government rates are hovering around the 10% mark despite the government's attempts to stimulate the economy.
segments.zh: 尽管政府试图刺激经济，但政府税率仍徘徊在 10% 左右。

segments.en: Example 2.
segments.zh: 例句二。

segments.en: The waiters kept hovering around us all night.
segments.zh: 服务员整晚都在我们身边徘徊。

segments.en: It was really annoying.
segments.zh: 这真的很烦人。

segments.en: Example 3.
segments.zh: 例句三。

segments.en: The company's margin this year is hovering around the 40% mark.
segments.zh: 该公司今年的利润率徘徊在 40% 左右。

segments.en: Okay, so pretty clear.
segments.zh: 好吧，很清楚。

segments.en: Hovering is sort of floating around one area.
segments.zh: 悬停有点漂浮在一个区域周围。

segments.en: Very good.
segments.zh: 很好。

segments.en: Now, let's move on to the next part.
segments.zh: 现在，让我们继续下一部分。

segments.en: We saw that we're going to have isolated downpours.
segments.zh: 我们看到将会出现局部性倾盆大雨。

segments.en: Isolated downpours.
segments.zh: 局部性倾盆大雨。

segments.en: Isolated downpours.
segments.zh: 局部性倾盆大雨。

segments.en: Okay, let's break this one down.
segments.zh: 好吧，让我们分解这一款。

segments.en: Let's start with downpour.
segments.zh: 让我们从倾盆大雨开始。

segments.en: A downpour is when you have a lot of rain, very strong rain.
segments.zh: 倾盆大雨就是雨下得很大、很猛的时候。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: For maybe a short amount of time, it's really raining heavily.
segments.zh: 可能很短的时间，下雨真的很大。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So that's what a downpour is.
segments.zh: 所以这就是一场倾盆大雨。

segments.en: And if we take a look at the first word, isolated.
segments.zh: 如果我们看第一个单词，孤立的。

segments.en: So in one small area.
segments.zh: 所以在一小块区域。

segments.en: Okay, confined it to a specific area.
segments.zh: 好的，将其限制在特定区域。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Okay, so we have an isolated downpour.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以我们有一个孤立的倾盆大雨。

segments.en: It'll be raining in one specific area.
segments.zh: 一个特定的区域会下雨。

segments.en: And you hear this a lot with weather language.
segments.zh: 你经常用天气语言听到这一点。

segments.en: You hear isolated showers, isolated snow storms.
segments.zh: 你听到孤立的阵雨，孤立的暴风雪。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: So it'll be in a specific area only.
segments.zh: 所以它只会在特定的区域。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So along with these showers and rain, we also talked about wind.
segments.zh: 因此，随着这些阵雨和雨水，我们还谈到了风。

segments.en: And we heard that we will have gusts reaching 23 miles per hour.
segments.zh: 我们听说我们的阵风将达到每小时 23 英里。

segments.en: So we're going to have gusts reaching 23 miles per hour.
segments.zh: 所以我们的阵风将达到每小时 23 英里。

segments.en: Gusts of wind.
segments.zh: 阵风。

segments.en: Okay, so can you explain to our listeners what gusts are?
segments.zh: 好的，你能向我们的听众解释什么是阵风吗？

segments.en: Okay, so a gust is a sudden increase in the amount of wind.
segments.zh: 好吧，阵风就是风力突然增强。

segments.en: Okay, so maybe we'll have normal wind and all of a sudden it will get really windy.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以也许我们会有正常的风，突然间它会变得非常有风。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: For a short amount of time.
segments.zh: 在很短的时间内。

segments.en: Okay, that's a gust.
segments.zh: 好吧，这是一个阵风。

segments.en: G-U-S-T, gust.
segments.zh: G-U-S-T，阵风。

segments.en: Gust of wind.
segments.zh: 阵风。

segments.en: And for our final word on Language Takeaway today, we're going to have sleet.
segments.zh: 今天我们语言要点的最后一个词是 sleet。

segments.en: Sleet.
segments.zh: 雨夹雪。

segments.en: Sleet.
segments.zh: 雨夹雪。

segments.en: All right, sleet is a terrible kind of weather.
segments.zh: 好吧，雨夹雪是一种可怕的天气。

segments.en: It's sort of a mixture between snow and rain.
segments.zh: 这是雪和雨之间的混合。

segments.en: So sleet is kind of this strange mix between ice and rain and snow.
segments.zh: 所以雨夹雪是冰雪雨雪之间的这种奇怪组合。

segments.en: So just imagine, it's not completely ice, so it's not solid, but it's not water, right?
segments.zh: 所以想象一下，它不是完全冰，所以它不是固体，但它不是水，对吧？

segments.en: It's not rain.
segments.zh: 这不是下雨。

segments.en: And it's not snow either.
segments.zh: 而且它也不是雪。

segments.en: No, it's in the middle.
segments.zh: 不，它在中间。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: All right, so sleet.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以雨夹雪。

segments.en: But what you really need to know is that it's terrible.
segments.zh: 但你真正需要知道的是它很糟糕。

segments.en: All right, so that's all the words we have today for Language Takeaway.
segments.zh: 好吧，这就是我们今天为语言要点所用的所有词。

segments.en: Let's move on now to Fluency Builder.
segments.zh: 现在让我们继续到流利表达。

segments.en: Fluency Builder.
segments.zh: 流利表达。

segments.en: All right, in Fluency Builder today, we're going to look at three phrases that are really common when you're talking about the weather.
segments.zh: 好吧，在流利表达中，我们将看看当您谈论天气时非常常见的三个短语。

segments.en: Now we heard in the dialogue that there was a cold front moving in.
segments.zh: 现在我们在对话中听说有一个冷锋进入。

segments.en: A cold front moving in.
segments.zh: 一个冷锋进入。

segments.en: A cold front is moving in.
segments.zh: 冷锋正在进来。

segments.en: Okay, so a cold front.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以冷锋。

segments.en: Imagine a wall of cold air and it comes towards a place and then it changes the pressure in the atmosphere.
segments.zh: 想象一下一堵冷空气墙，它朝一个地方走来，然后它改变了大气中的压力。

segments.en: Okay, so a very sudden amount of cold air that comes into a place.
segments.zh: 好的，所以突然有大量的冷空气进入一个地方。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So we say a cold front is moving in.
segments.zh: 所以我们说冷锋正在进入。

segments.en: So we always think of these cold fronts or warm fronts as moving.
segments.zh: 所以我们总是认为这些冷锋或暖锋是移动的。

segments.en: So you can either say they're moving in or you can say a cold front is coming in.
segments.zh: 所以你可以说它们正在移入，也可以说冷锋正在移入。

segments.en: Okay, very good.
segments.zh: 好，很好。

segments.en: And okay, we have a cold front that's moving in and we're going to have winds that will be coming in from the northeast.
segments.zh: 好吧，我们有一个冷锋正在进入，我们将有来自东北部的风。

segments.en: Okay, winds coming in from.
segments.zh: 好吧，风来了。

segments.en: Okay, winds coming in from.
segments.zh: 好吧，风来了。

segments.en: So when I say it's coming in from.
segments.zh: 所以当我说它是进来的时候。

segments.en: You're talking about its origin, where it starts.
segments.zh: 你说的是它的起源，它的起点。

segments.en: Okay, so if I change the noun and I don't say winds anymore but maybe I'll say my friends.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以如果我改变名词并且我不再说风，但也许我会说我的朋友们。

segments.en: My friends are coming in from Chicago.
segments.zh: 我的朋友是从芝加哥来的。

segments.en: So they are arriving from Chicago.
segments.zh: 所以他们从芝加哥抵达。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: So what else can I say?
segments.zh: 那我还能说什么呢？

segments.en: Or you can also say the kids are coming in from outside.
segments.zh: 或者你也可以说孩子们是从外面进来的。

segments.en: Okay, so where they were before.
segments.zh: 好吧，他们以前在哪里。

segments.en: Very good.
segments.zh: 很好。

segments.en: So coming in from.
segments.zh: 所以从中进来。

segments.en: You can change the noun a little bit and you can form these new sentences.
segments.zh: 你可以稍微改变名词，你可以形成这些新句子。

segments.en: Great.
segments.zh: 太好了。

segments.en: Now our final phrase.
segments.zh: 现在是我们的最后一句话。

segments.en: We heard the announcer say it's going to be a cold one.
segments.zh: 我们听到播音员说，会很冷。

segments.en: It's going to be a cold one.
segments.zh: 会很冷的。

segments.en: It's going to be a cold one.
segments.zh: 会很冷的。

segments.en: So I have this phrase, it's going to be a cold one.
segments.zh: 所以我有这句话，它会很冷。

segments.en: What do I mean by a cold one?
segments.zh: 我说的冷的是什么意思？

segments.en: Okay, so the one represents the event.
segments.zh: 好的，那一代表事件。

segments.en: Of the day.
segments.zh: 当天。

segments.en: Okay, so it's going to be a cold day.
segments.zh: 好吧，那就是寒冷的一天。

segments.en: Yes.
segments.zh: 是的。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Now we can obviously change the adjective, right?
segments.zh: 现在我们显然可以改变形容词，对吧？

segments.en: So it's going to be a hot one, it's going to be a long one, it's going to be a long day.
segments.zh: 所以可以说是很热的一天，也可以说是很漫长的一天。

segments.en: Alright.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: But the one can mean anything.
segments.zh: 但这个 one 可以指任何东西。

segments.en: Okay, so it can be a day, it can be an event.
segments.zh: 好的，所以它可以是一天，它可以是一个事件。

segments.en: A meeting.
segments.zh: 一次会议。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: A project.
segments.zh: 一个项目。

segments.en: So for example, if we're going to a meeting, I might say, hey Marco, this is going to be a hard one.
segments.zh: 因此，例如，如果我们要去开会，我可能会说，嘿，马可，这将是一场艰难的会议。

segments.en: Okay, so the one represents the meeting.
segments.zh: 好的，这个 one 指的就是会议。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: A hard meeting.
segments.zh: 艰难的会议。

segments.en: Alright, I think this is a very good phrase and it's very commonly used, so why don't we listen to some more examples of how we can use it's going to be a something one.
segments.zh: 好吧，我认为这是一个非常好的短语，并且非常常用，所以我们为什么不听一些关于我们如何使用它的例子。

segments.en: Example one.
segments.zh: 例句一。

segments.en: Temperatures are forecasted to hit 37 degrees today.
segments.zh: 预计今天的气温将达到 37 度。

segments.en: It's going to be a hot one, folks.
segments.zh: 各位，今天会很热。

segments.en: Example two.
segments.zh: 例句二。

segments.en: It's only 8am and I've got a hundred emails already.
segments.zh: 现在只有早上 8 点，我已经收到了一百封电子邮件。

segments.en: It's going to be a long one today.
segments.zh: 今天会很漫长。

segments.en: Example three.
segments.zh: 例句三。

segments.en: I haven't studied at all for the exam.
segments.zh: 我根本没有为考试学习。

segments.en: It's going to be a tough one.
segments.zh: 这会是艰难的一场。

segments.en: Okay, so some great examples and I think it's time for us to listen to this dialogue again and now we can understand all these words and phrases that we've just talked about.
segments.zh: 好的，所以一些很好的例子，我认为是时候再次听这个对话了，现在我们可以理解我们刚刚谈到的所有这些单词和短语。

segments.en: And now, let's go to Kenny Williams for today's weather forecast.
segments.zh: 现在，让我们去肯尼威廉姆斯进行今天的天气预报。

segments.en: Thank you Bill and good morning Salt Lake City.
segments.zh: 谢谢比尔和早上好盐湖城。

segments.en: What's the weather looking like today, Kenny?
segments.zh: 肯尼，今天的天气怎么样？

segments.en: Well, it's a bit of a mixed bag in Utah today.
segments.zh: 今天犹他州各地的天气不太一样。

segments.en: We've got heavy cloud cover here in northern Utah and we're calling for scattered showers throughout the day with a daytime high of 45 degrees.
segments.zh: 犹他州北部云层很厚，全天预报有零星阵雨，白天最高气温四十五度。

segments.en: Now, if we move down to the south of the state, we can see that a cold front is moving in.
segments.zh: 再看该州南部，一股冷锋正移入。

segments.en: We can expect clear skies, but it will be quite cold with temperatures hovering around the 30 degree mark.
segments.zh: 我们可以期待晴朗的天空，但天气会非常寒冷，气温徘徊在 30 度左右。

segments.en: It's a chilly day, folks, so don't forget your coats.
segments.zh: 今天挺冷的，各位别忘了穿外套。

segments.en: What about tomorrow, Kenny?
segments.zh: 肯尼，明天呢？

segments.en: Do you have good news for us?
segments.zh: 你有好消息要告诉我们吗？

segments.en: Well, it'll be a rainy day for northern Utah.
segments.zh: 犹他州北部明天会下雨。

segments.en: We can expect some isolated downpours in the morning.
segments.zh: 早晨局部地区可能有大雨。

segments.en: Winds will be coming in from the northeast with gusts reaching 23 miles per hour.
segments.zh: 风将从东北部吹来，阵风达到每小时 23 英里。

segments.en: Salt Lake City can expect the rain to turn to sleet in the evening.
segments.zh: 盐湖城傍晚可能由雨转为雨夹雪。

segments.en: Things are looking a bit better for the south.
segments.zh: 南部的情况要好一些。

segments.en: We'll see cloudy skies with a chance of showers.
segments.zh: 多云，有阵雨的可能。

segments.en: Later in the day, we can expect partly cloudy skies with a forecast high of 38 degrees.
segments.zh: 当天晚些时候转为局部多云，预计最高气温三十八度。

segments.en: You heard it, folks.
segments.zh: 各位都听到了吧。

segments.en: It's going to be a cold one.
segments.zh: 会很冷的。

segments.en: That's right, Bill.
segments.zh: 没错，比尔。

segments.en: We'll have more later on today on the 6 o'clock news.
segments.zh: 更多天气消息请关注今晚六点新闻。

segments.en: That's the weather forecast for this morning.
segments.zh: 以上就是今早的天气预报。

segments.en: Okay, so we know that in English-speaking countries, the weather is always, always, always a great subject of conversation for small talk, right?
segments.zh: 好的，所以我们知道在英语国家，天气总是，总是，总是一个很好的闲聊话题，对吧？

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: If you ever want to talk to somebody or start a conversation, the weather is always the number one topic.
segments.zh: 如果您想与某人交谈或开始对话，天气始终是第一大话题。

segments.en: Yep.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: And we actually have a phrase in this dialogue that would be great for starting a conversation.
segments.zh: 实际上，我们在这次对话中有一个短语，非常适合开始对话。

segments.en: Like for example, imagine if you lived here in Utah and you were, you know, wanting to start a conversation with someone, you could say, it sure is a cold one today, isn't it?
segments.zh: 例如，想象你住在犹他州，想和某人搭话，你可以说：今天真冷啊，不是吗？

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: That's a great way of starting a conversation and English-speaking people love to talk about the weather, as you say.
segments.zh: 正如你所说，这是开始对话的好方法，说英语的人喜欢谈论天气。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So, guys, if you have any questions about weather vocabulary or if you want to practice talking about the weather, come to our website at EnglishPod.com.
segments.zh: 所以，伙计们，如果您对天气词汇有任何疑问，或者您想练习谈论天气，请访问我们的网站 englishpod.com。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: Erica and I are always there to answer any questions or doubts you may have.
segments.zh: Erica 和我总是在那里回答您可能有的任何问题或疑问。

segments.en: And also, if you have any stories about crazy weather maybe in the countries you're from, let us know.
segments.zh: 而且，如果您有任何关于您所在国家/地区的疯狂天气的故事，请告诉我们。

segments.en: So, thanks for downloading, you guys, and until next time, goodbye.
segments.zh: 所以，感谢您的下载，你们，直到下一次，再见。

segments.en: Bye.
segments.zh: 再见。
